label: GO
call: Go with D, run with B's clips: land the first paying gyms by hand and film every build. Open the new handles now, but sell one thing, the gym voice agent, to gym owners. Skip broad AI tips.

why.point: Broad AI tips is a commodity; a jujutsu coach building AI for gyms is a niche nobody can copy.
40 personal messages a week land buyers faster than a zero-follower account.
Zero customers is an offer problem: one productized agent, 7-day install, capped guarantee.
Tomorrow's build is the content; every message carries a clip.
A missed call turning into a booked trial is a before and after gym owners forward.

minority.quote: Without a number, "byproduct" turns into zero posts, and you can't judge a channel you never fed.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Content alone brings inbound gym owners within 60 days.

next_steps.action: Get $300/month terms signed, deliver and film the agent, time every hour, grab both handles.
10 clips up by Nov 1; after 7 days of real calls, 40 messages with the result.
3 paying gyms, 1 referral or testimonial, then turn the template into a fixed product.

kill_criteria: Under 2 calls from 100 messages: widen past gyms. Under 3 paying gyms by Dec 31: stop custom builds.
conditions: 40 gym-owner messages go out first each week, each with a clip
About 6 hours outreach and delivery, 4 content; at least 5 clips a week
Agent runs 7 days and books 1 trial before any results post

fights.story: Gary V, Naval, and Buffett opened on content; Hormozi and Graham on outreach. Graham's math moved four seats. Clients first, content as a byproduct with a floor.

fights.crux: New accounts or the jujutsu pages?

Naval wanted a product now; Graham said sell three by hand first and Naval conceded. One name, one template, productize after three.

revisit: Dec 31, with paying gyms, close rate, hours per build, running cost per client, and inbound DMs.
